purpose: Test whether AtomGit-hosted models can distinguish evidence relevance to a future task and procedural vs instance-binding evidence without touching any frozen E2-R17 scientific data or outcomes.

transport.transport_void_rule: Any invocation with tool.started, tool_calls > 0, rounds > 1, or usage_rows != 1 is TRANSPORT_VOID and is not replaced.

cases.future_task: In a new workbook, copy a block of formulas from B2:D8 to F5:H11 while preserving the same relative-reference behavior.

interpretation_boundary: This panel qualifies model relevance-gating behavior only. It cannot establish Search-Projection Censoring, a causal learner-projection effect, structural moderation, natural transport, or method superiority.
